retained_operational_points: Object connections determine behavior; the default audio-effect path is plugin~ to plugout~.

reference_spans.heading: Choose a method and confirm availability

retained_operational_points: Built-in Max device families include instruments, effects, and MIDI Tools.
Suite or Standard plus Max for Live supports opening devices in Max; available devices vary by edition.
All eight DS instruments are individually covered, including audition gesture, decay, volume, pitch control, and unique synthesis controls.
Two independently leveled tones, white noise, high-/band-pass cutoff, Clave-enabled Repeat, Pitch, Decay, Volume, and upper-display audition.
Filtered noise/impulse through panned delays; Sloppy controls delay separation, Tail adds noise, Spread 0% mono/100% widened, Tone, Tune, Decay, Volume, audition.
Sine/pulse and high-passed-noise design; high-pass Tone cutoff, Pitch, Decay, Volume, audition.
Low-pass Tone, feedback-driven noise via Feedb., FM amount via Amnt, modulation-type blend via Mod, global Pitch, Decay, Volume, audition.
White/pink noise choice, Tone high-pass cutoff, pitched resonant high-pass with 12/24 dB slopes and Attack, global Pitch, Decay, Volume, audition.
Modulated sine; Pitch in Hz, Drive distortion, OT harmonics, Attack smoothing, Click transient, Env pitch modulation, Decay, Volume, audition.
Pitched oscillator/noise; Color versus Tone, low/high/band-pass noise filtering, Tune, Decay, Volume, audition.
Impulse/oscillator design; Pitch in Hz, Color gain/cutoff, Tone resonant band-pass levels, Bend pitch envelope, Decay, Volume, audition.
Align Delay, Envelope Follower, LFO, and Shaper are covered individually; repeated mapping behavior is consolidated without losing per-device differences.
Time milliseconds for A/V or stereo offsets; Samples for latency offsets; Distance meters/feet for physical PA spacing.
Distance temperature compensation supports Celsius/Fahrenheit.
Link L/R applies left settings to both channels and disables the right slider.
Audio amplitude becomes a mapped curve; Map/Unmap and eight targets via Multimap.
Default Modulation preserves base edits, bipolar/unipolar polarity and amount; Remote Control exclusively owns the target within Min/Max.
Gain, Rise/Fall, time-versus-beat Delay; default track-input detector.
Audio Routing triangle, Sidechain, Audio From source and Pre FX/Post FX/Post Mixer or Rack channel, Direct/S.C. meters.
Sidechain Mix 0% track input and 100% external source.
Eight-target mapping and Modulation/Remote distinction retained.
Nine waveforms: Sine/Up/Down/Triangle/Square/Random/Bin/Stray/Glider.
Shape is unavailable for Random/Bin/Stray/Glider; Steps up to 24, unavailable for Random/Bin/Square.
Jitter, Smooth, Hz versus beat Rate, Hz-only x10, Depth 0/100%, signed Offset centered at 0%.
Phase 0–100%, Hold retains output and resumes from it; R retriggers from Phase.
Eight-target mapping and Modulation/Remote distinction retained.
Add breakpoint, Alt/Option-drag curvature, Shift-click removal, Clear, six presets, Grid/Snap, output scope.
Jitter/Smooth, signed Offset centered at zero, Phase 0–100%, R disabled in Sync Time Mode.
Loop repeats, 1-Shot uses mappable T, Manual scrubs; Rate Hz/beats, Depth 0/100%.
All six named MIDI effects and all three MPE Control sub-sources are covered.
Eight-target mapping and Modulation/Remote distinction retained.
Free note triggers, Sync beat retriggers, Loop Global Time rate, Echo Env Echo Time and Env Feedback.
Trigger LED, Global Time 1.00 unity and proportional stretching/compression, Amount 0/100%.
ADSR definitions, ADR slopes and direct display editing, Velocity peak scaling, Sustain hold versus one-shot progression.
Five Mod Source tabs and ten sources: Velocity/Modwheel/Pitchbend/Pressure/Keytrack/Expression/Random/Increment/Slide/Sustain.
Map target per source; Modulate preserves base-value edits with polarity and Output Range Max, Remote uses Output Range Min/Max and owns values.
Linear two-point Curve A versus S three-point A/B upper/lower segments, inverse Curve Link, Min/Max, X-Y, direct display edits.
Increment Steps 1–32 and transport-stop reset to minimum on first note after restart; per-note Random Amount.
Linear/logarithmic smoothing, separate Rise/Fall 0–1000 ms.
Note display includes keyboard notes, root/chord, velocity; Flow includes notes, pitch bend, aftertouch, Freeze/Clear.
MPE display streams note, velocity, slide, pressure, per-note pitch.
Reshape incoming per-note data or convert to global MIDI for non-MPE devices.
Press/Slide/NotePB independent enables, selected curve foreground, linear/S curves, Min/Max, linked/unlinked segments, X-Y/direct manipulation.
Advanced triangle exposes per-source Smooth and Rise/Fall; specialized controls retained in child entries.
Per-note pressure after the strike; Default for notes lacking MPE, Swap to Slide, Press to AT for monophonic aftertouch.
Vertical expression via CC74; Default, Centered zero at pad center with growth away from center.
Abs absolute, Rel middle-start regardless of initial touch with held-note movement, Ons updates only at Note On and disables smoothing.
Slide to Mod converts to CC1.
Horizontal per-note pitch bend; Pitch Range 2x example maps controller ±48 semitones to instrument ±24 semitones.
Higher scaling can increase non-pitch modulation range per gesture; NotePB to PB converts to standard pitch bend.
Added MIDI notes with diminishing velocity; Sync counts sixteenths, 4 equals a quarter note, Delay Time percentage offsets and milliseconds when Sync off.
Input Thru versus Mute, per-repeat Pitch, Delay velocity amount, Fback feedback.
MPE toggle retains expression; off filters it. Press/Slide/Note PB feedback below 100% progressively decays each expression stream.
Note-triggered eight-target breakpoint modulation with Modulation/Remote distinction.
Point/curve creation, Shift-click, Clear, six presets, Grid/Snap, scope and trigger LED, Jitter/Smooth, signed Offset.
Ctrl/Cmd-click creates one larger sustain point, held until release; Loop repeats while held and bypasses sustain.
Velocity 0% ignores velocity; higher values scale depth. Hz/beats Rate, Depth 0/100%, Echo feedback and Time interval.

coverage.section_title: MIDI and Key Remote Control — introduction

reference_spans.heading: Choose a method and confirm availability
Relative Session navigation and Clip View control

retained_operational_points: Targets include Session slots, switches, radio choices including crossfader assignment, continuous mixer controls, and the crossfader.
Session mappings are slot-bound, not clip-bound.

reference_spans.heading: Choose a method and confirm availability

retained_operational_points: Hardware remote control is distinct from MIDI-track input; a remotely assigned note no longer plays the track instrument.
Push 1/2/3 supported; Link, Tempo & MIDI Settings via Ctrl/Cmd comma; observe MIDI indicators.
Select named surface and input/output ports, up to six supported surfaces simultaneously.
Dump is conditional and requires the hardware to be ready for preset reception; actual manufacturer setup is not supplied.
Mappings follow selected devices and can be manually overridden with relevant Remote ports enabled.
Device title-bar Lock to menu pins supported surfaces, hand icon marks locking; arming a MIDI track defaults to instrument lock.
Some surfaces cannot lock; instant mappings do not appear in Mapping Browser.
Input Remote enables manual mapping for unsupported hardware; any number of MIDI ports can be merged.
Output Remote is needed for controller LEDs/motor-fader feedback; verify incoming messages with Control Bar indicators.

reference_spans.heading: Choose Takeover Mode for absolute controls

retained_operational_points: Absolute bank switching mismatch: None jumps immediately, Pick-Up waits for equal value then follows 1:1, Value Scaling smoothly converges then follows 1:1.
Manual MIDI/key/Macro modes expose matching mappings, target path/name, source, Min/Max editing and inversion.
Backspace Windows/Delete macOS removes selected assignments; context-dependent instant mappings are absent.
MIDI Map highlights eligible targets blue; click target, send hardware message, inspect Mapping Browser, exit mode.
Closed browser can be opened with Ctrl+Alt+B Windows/Cmd+Option+B macOS.
Slots follow Launch Mode; Note On toggles switches/cycles radio choices; one note toggles continuous Min/Max, range supplies equally spaced values.
Chromatic slot assignment uses root held while adding lower and upper range bounds.
Seven-bit 0–127 mapping; slot threshold 63/64, general switches threshold 64, radio/continuous controls span options/range.
Track/device activators use mapping Min/Max membership, inverted limits reverse on/off membership behavior.
Pitch bend and 14-bit Absolute use 0–16383, split at 8191/8192.

reference_spans.heading: Choose Takeover Mode for absolute controls
Relative Session navigation and Clip View control

retained_operational_points: Relative increments/decrements avoid absolute-position jumps; Signed Bit, Signed Bit 2, Bin Offset, Twos Complement, and linear variants.
Hardware may accelerate; slow left movement aids automatic type/acceleration detection, with explicit Status Bar mode override.
Increment/decrement correspond to slot Note On/Off, switch on/off, radio next/previous, and encoding-specific continuous movement.

reference_spans.heading: Relative Session navigation and Clip View control

retained_operational_points: Assignable mapping strip supplies scene up/down, scene number scrolling, highlighted scene launch/cancel, and per-track highlighted-row clip launch.
Select Next Scene on Launch in Record, Warp & Launch enables sequential advance; highlighted scene stays centered.

reference_spans.heading: Relative Session navigation and Clip View control

retained_operational_points: Mappings follow currently selected/multi-selected clips and can affect any clip in a Set; prefer relative control to avoid parameter jumps.
KEY mode red targets, click target, press key, inspect browser, exit mode; use View menu if browser hidden.
Keys follow slot Launch Mode, toggle switches, cycle radio choices; this is separate from pseudo-MIDI keyboard note generation.

synthesis_policy: All domain procedures and numerical/UI claims are source-derived paraphrases. Only explicitly listed safety and verification guidance is synthesis. No claim is experiment-backed.

reference_headings: Choose a method and confirm availability

reference_headings: Build, edit, save, and package Max devices
synthesis.rule: Preserve work before restarting, prefer isolated Save As scope for experiments, preserve custom curves before replacement, and remove only intended mappings.
Confirm indexing/editor launch, compare audition with sequenced input, and verify delay units/channel linkage and intended timing direction.
Check visible signal, source, mode, range, global amount, trigger indicators, and Hold/loop state before changing downstream targets.
Inspect incoming and transformed MIDI/MPE independently; test global-conversion behavior with chords rather than assuming a simultaneous-note arbitration rule.
Confirm authorization and hardware readiness before a preset dump; do not guess hardware-specific receive setup.

reference_headings: Relative Session navigation and Clip View control
synthesis.rule: Inspect current selections and visible control purposes; test navigation separately from launching and report only observed results.
